description: This file implements a minimal Supabase authentication client using httpx for HTTP requests. It provides methods for user sign-up and sign-in by interacting with Supabase's REST API endpoints.

classes.name: SupabaseAuthClient
classes.description: A lightweight client for authenticating users with Supabase via REST API, avoiding heavy SDK dependencies.

methods.name: __init__(self, supabase_url: str, supabase_key: str, site_url: str)
methods.description: Initializes the SupabaseAuthClient with the provided URL, key, and site URL, setting headers for subsequent requests.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] sign_up(self, *, email: str, password: str)
methods.description: Performs user signup by calling Supabase's signup endpoint with email and password.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] sign_in(self, *, email: str, password: str)
methods.description: Performs user signin by calling Supabase's token endpoint with email and password.

ctags.name: __init__
ctags.pattern: /^    def __init__(self, supabase_url: str, supabase_key: str, site_url: str):$/
ctags.signature: (self, supabase_url: str, supabase_key: str, site_url: str)

ctags.name: sign_in
ctags.pattern: /^    async def sign_in(self, *, email: str, password: str) -> Dict[str, Any]:$/

ctags.name: sign_up
ctags.pattern: /^    async def sign_up(self, *, email: str, password: str) -> Dict[str, Any]:$/
